adds.rationale: Symbotic's acquisition of Walmart's Advanced Systems and Robotics business (announced Jan 16, 2025, closed Jan 28, 2025) is a concrete commercial milestone that adds over $5B to backlog and expands its addressable warehouse-automation market, giving the watchlist a second, more individual-name-concentrated robotics exposure alongside the BOTZ ETF.

news_evidence.summary: Symbotic completes acquisition of Walmart's Advanced Systems and Robotics business and signs related commercial agreement ($200M cash + up to $350M contingent, plus $520M reciprocal deal; backlog to grow by more than $5B)
Symbotic shares surge 19% on news of the Walmart Advanced Systems and Robotics business acquisition

removes.rationale: Intuitive Machines' second consecutive lunar lander mission (IM-2/Athena) tipped over on landing on March 6, 2025, ending the surface mission in under 13 hours versus a planned 10 days -- a fundamental thesis breach on the company's core landing technology after IM-1 suffered a similar off-nominal touchdown in 2024, while RKLB and ASTS retain the watchlist's rockets/spacecraft exposure.

news_evidence.summary: Athena's altimeter failed during descent, the lander struck a plateau, tipped over and skidded into a crater; mission ended within 13 hours as power depleted, versus a planned 10-day surface mission
NASA confirms it received some data from the lander before Intuitive Machines ended the lunar mission

rationale_overall: One swap this quarter: LUNR exits on a fundamental thesis breach (a second consecutive tipped-over lunar landing, IM-2/Athena on 2025-03-06), while SYM enters on a concrete, dated commercial milestone (the Walmart Advanced Systems and Robotics acquisition closed 2025-01-28) that deepens robotics-wave exposure beyond the BOTZ ETF alone. The dominant-AI-wave core (MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA) is held -- Q1 2025 brought a DeepSeek-driven AI wobble (2025-01-27) but also continued Azure/Cloud growth and NVDA's GTC 2025 Blackwell Ultra cycle, so no evidence of a crest worth trimming into. Rockets/spacecraft (RKLB, ASTS), defense (LMT, ITA), nuclear fuel-cycle (LEU, CCJ), tankers (STNG), and demographics (ISRG, CTRE) are all kept on continuing dated Q1 evidence with no breach. Nuclear-utility/SMR hyperscaler PPA deals are all 2024-dated background, not new this quarter. Net effect: watchlist stays at the 16-ticker cap with one thematic refresh inside the rockets/robotics tilt.
